title: Configs & Backups
text: Configs & Backups A config profile captures the menu settings you want to reuse. Use separate named profiles for different setups, and keep a copy of your current profile before trying someone else's. Config folder and menu C:\scooby\RDR2\configs Settings → GUI → Configs Named profiles use the .config extension. Save a profile Install and load Back up content Troubleshooting Save your current settings Set up the menu as you want it, then open Settings → GUI → Configs . Enter a New config name and select Save New . The saved profile becomes the active config. Use Open Folder to find its .config file. To update it later, use Quick Save Active . To overwrite another selected profile, use Save Selected and confirm the overwrite. Choose a simple name such as MySetup . The menu adds the extension. default is reserved and is not a normal named profile. Auto Save Features controls whether feature toggles and values are saved automatically. With it off, feature changes remain live for the session; a manual config save still captures them. Install and load a shared profile Get a compatible Scooby RDR2 .config file and extract it if needed. Open the Configs screen and select Open Folder . Copy the file directly into C:\scooby\RDR2\configs . Keep its extension. Select Refresh , choose the profile in Config Library , then select Load Selected . You can also double-click its row. Check the active profile name and review the loaded feature settings before continuing. C:\scooby\RDR2\configs\ MySetup.config SharedSetup.config A config changes menu settings. It does not copy the author's Lua scripts, outfit files, or image assets to your computer. Install those separately if the setup depends on them. Back up your personal content Close the game and Scooby, then copy the folders you want to preserve to your backup location: C:\scooby\RDR2\configs — settings and named profiles. C:\scooby\RDR2\outfits — player outfits and the Horse subfolder. C:\scooby\RDR2\lua — scripts and their supporting configuration/data. C:\scooby\RDR2\theme — saved appearance JSON files. C:\scooby\RDR2\images — custom images and ListUI image themes. Preserve filenames and folder structure. To restore a file, copy it back to the same location, then refresh the relevant library. Refreshing the Lua library stops running scripts, so start the scripts you need again afterward. If a profile does not save or load Not listed: check the .config extension, place the file directly in the configs folder, and refresh. The internal default.config is intentionally hidden from the named-profile list. Invalid name: use 1–64 characters without Windows filename symbols such as \ / : * ? , and avoid the reserved name default . Incompatible settings: restore the original file or ask for an export from a compatible Scooby RDR2 version. Renaming a GTA config does not convert it. Images or scripts are missing: restore those files separately as well as the config.

title: Horse Outfits
text: Horse Outfits The horse outfit editor works on your active, saddle, or recent horse. Its saves apply equipment to an existing horse, so have the horse you want to customize available before loading a preset. Horse outfit folder and menu C:\scooby\RDR2\outfits\Horse Self → Outfits → Outfits → Horse Choose Editor , Saved Outfits , or Presets inside the Horse tab. This is part of the Premium outfit editor. Choose your horse Install Save and share Troubleshooting Choose and customize your horse Mount or call the horse you want to edit. The editor can keep targeting your saddle or recent horse after you dismount. Open the Horse → Editor tab and select Refresh Horse . Wait for the compatible equipment scan to finish. Adjust the available items and textures, or open Presets to try a built-in horse appearance. Use a matching horse model when possible. Equipment and coat compatibility can differ between models. Loading a saved horse outfit applies its components to the current target; it does not spawn a horse or change that horse into the saved model. Install a shared horse outfit Get a horse outfit exported by Scooby RDR2 and extract the archive if necessary. Paste C:\scooby\RDR2\outfits\Horse into File Explorer. Copy the .json directly into that folder. Open Horse → Saved Outfits and clear the saved-outfit search if needed. Select the file and use Load Selected . If Apply saved horse outfit when clicked is enabled, selecting the row loads it immediately. C:\scooby\RDR2\outfits\Horse\ MyHorseOutfit.json Use the horse editor's own export format. Player outfit JSON files and unrelated legacy horse files are not interchangeable with these saves. Save and share your horse's equipment With the target horse available, open Horse → Saved Outfits . Enter a Horse outfit name , then select Save Current . Alternatively, use Quick Save for an automatically generated name. Back up or share the JSON from outfits\Horse , including the horse model you used. Choose a new name when you want to keep an earlier version. If your horse outfit does not work No horse found: mount or call your horse, then use Refresh Horse . No compatible slots yet: let the equipment scan finish before editing. File is missing: keep it directly in outfits\Horse , confirm the .json extension, clear the search, and reopen Saved Outfits. Unsupported horse outfit format: ask for a save made with the Scooby RDR2 horse editor. Renaming another file does not convert it. Appearance differs: try the same horse model the author used. Built-in legacy presets apply a compatible coat base, while native saves retain individual equipment components.

title: Getting Luas
text: Getting Luas Choose scripts written for Scooby RDR2 . You can find shared scripts in the Scooby community or get them from their author. GTA 5 and RedM scripts may need a port before they work here. Lua folder and menu C:\scooby\RDR2\lua Settings → Lua Scripts → Scripts The workspace heading is Lua Editor . Install Run and stop Create a script Troubleshooting Install and run a downloaded script Download the RDR2 script and extract it if it arrives in an archive. Keep its supporting libraries, configuration, and assets. Open Settings → Lua Scripts and select Open Lua Folder . You can also paste C:\scooby\RDR2\lua into File Explorer. Place the main .lua file directly in that folder. Keep supporting files in the locations specified by the author. Open the Scripts tab and select Refresh Scripts . Select the file in Script Library , then select Run / Reload . Check the Runtime panel for its running status. C:\scooby\RDR2\lua\ MyRDR2Script.lua ScoobyRDR2Template.lua The script list supports single .lua files and package folders. A package uses main.lua , init.lua , or its folder name as the entry point. Keep the package modules together and avoid an extra archive wrapper folder. Keep file extensions visible. Download Frontier, the standalone RDR2 Lua GUI , or browse the current Lua API . Frontier supports Lua54 and LuaJIT hosts with API 2.1.0 or a compatible newer 2.x version. Reload, stop, and refresh scripts Run / Reload: loads the selected script and enables it. Reload: restarts a script from the Runtime panel after changes. Stop: disables that script. Stop All Scripts disables the running list. Refresh Scripts: discovers changed files without restarting scripts that are already running. Use Reload to recreate the selected script state after editing. Scripts start disabled when the library is initialized. Run the scripts you need from this screen; the GTA 5 auto-run checkbox is not part of this RDR2 workflow. To remove a script, stop it, remove its main file from the Lua folder, and refresh. Keep any configuration or data files you want to reuse. Start your own script Use New RDR2 Script to create a starter file, or open the bundled ScoobyRDR2Template.lua with Open in Editor . In Code Editor , enable API Documentation to see RDR2 function descriptions and examples. A script may draw its own window or expose its controls in a separate menu. Check the author's instructions if the Runtime panel says it is running but you cannot find its controls. If the script does not work Not in the list: extract the archive, keep the single script or complete package directly inside the Lua folder, clear the search, and refresh. Frontier should have lua\Frontier\main.lua . Error on startup: read the message in Runtime or the Console tab. Confirm that the script supports Scooby RDR2 and your menu version. Missing module or image: restore the full download and its expected supporting folders. Runtime or API mismatch: read the required API/game/runtime in the error. LuaJIT uses Lua 5.1 syntax; Lua 5.4 scripts may require the Lua54 host. Refreshing alone does not stop other scripts.

title: Features Not Working
text: Features Not Working If Scooby loads but none of the features do anything , that almost always means one thing: CS2 HAS BEEN UPDATED AND SCOOBY NEEDS UPDATING TO MATCH Valve patches CS2 regularly, and every patch moves things around internally. Until Scooby is rebuilt against the new version, the menu will open but the features will not work. How long does an update take? It varies. Sometimes it is within an hour of the CS2 update, sometimes a day , sometimes up to about five days - realistically, whenever we have time to get to it. The CS2 menu is completely free , so it sits behind the paid products in the queue. We would rather be straight with you about that than promise a turnaround we cannot always hit. What to do in the meantime There is nothing to fix on your end - reinstalling will not help. Check the Discord for the current status, and update the loader once the new build is announced.

title: CS2 Custom Models: Install Folder, Players, Arms and Weapons
text: CS2 Custom Models: Install Folder, Players, Arms and Weapons Game folder Install a package Refresh & preview Players Self & arms Weapons Reset Troubleshooting Where do I put the model files? Install the model package inside CS2's game\csgo folder. For the usual Windows Steam location, the full folder is: C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Counter-Strike Global Offensive\game\csgo\ If your Steam library is on another drive, use that library's steamapps\common\Counter-Strike Global Offensive\game\csgo\ folder instead. CS2 still uses the Counter-Strike Global Offensive installation folder name. Keep the package's folder structure Copy the package's contents into game\csgo , keeping its original paths. A folder such as agents , models , weapons or materials should sit directly inside csgo . The model and its materials, textures, animations and other dependencies need to stay together. Examples of final locations, depending on how the author packaged the model: Counter-Strike Global Offensive\ └─ game\ └─ csgo\ ├─ agents\models\author\character\character.vmdl_c ├─ characters\models\author\character\character.vmdl_c ├─ models\author\character\character.vmdl_c ├─ weapons\author\ak47\weapon.vmdl_c ├─ models\weapons\author\weapon.vmdl_c ├─ phase2\weapons\author\weapon.vmdl_c └─ materials\author\... These are examples, not folders to rename your package into. Use the author's actual filenames and directories. Compiled files contain references to those paths. Install the complete package Close CS2. Extract the downloaded package so you can see its files and folders. Find the package's content folders. If the archive includes a game\csgo wrapper, open it and copy the folders inside it. Copy those folders into your installed game\csgo folder. Merge matching folders and include all supplied dependencies. The result should be game\csgo\models\... , for example; an extra archive-name folder or a second csgo folder breaks resource paths. Start CS2 and load Scooby. See How to Load Scooby in CS2 if you need the loading steps. Open Custom models in the sidebar, choose Players , Self or Weapon , and press Refresh list . Use a CS2-compatible compiled Source 2 package with .vmdl_c model files. Source files such as .vmdl need to be compiled by the model author. Renaming a file's extension does not compile or convert it. Keeping a ZIP in Downloads or a model in Scooby's package library alone does not install its game resources. The complete package must exist at its expected paths below game\csgo . Refresh the list, preview, then apply Choose the target you want to change and use Search models... to find its package. Select a model in the list on the left. Scooby checks its dependencies in the background and shows its 3D preview on the right when it is ready. Press Apply model to assign the selection. Browsing a model by itself does not apply it. Refresh list rescans the active category. The top Refresh button refreshes all model categories. Wait for background work to finish after adding or replacing files. Refresh discovers installed files; it does not download missing dependencies. Default model previews the currently loaded model when your player is available. In the menu, the player preview can use your equipped agent. To remove an assignment, select Default model and press Apply model . Players: global, CT/T and individual agents The Players tab controls other players. Use the Team and Agent dropdowns to choose the scope before applying a model: Global: a fallback for CT and T players. CT → All CT agents or T → All T agents: a fallback for that team. CT or T → a named agent: a separate replacement for that original agent model. The order is individual agent → team → global → original model . A more specific assignment takes priority. For example, set a global model, choose a different CT model, then give one CT agent its own replacement. Your own character is configured under Self . Applying Default to an individual agent removes that assignment, so its team or global fallback may still appear. To return everyone to their original models, clear the remaining team/global assignments too, or use Reset All . Self: your body, arms and hands Open Self and select Player body to change your own character. The body selection uses matching first-person arms and hands when the model includes an authored first-person mesh. Choose First-person arms to apply a separate arms model. That explicit selection takes priority over the body model's arms. Applying Default in the arms list clears the explicit choice and lets the body supply its matching arms when available. A body-only package cannot create matching hands automatically. If the body changes but the hands stay ordinary, check that the package includes first-person geometry or install the author's matching arms package. Weapon: matching world and first-person models Open Weapon , select a package made for the weapon you want to replace, and press Apply model . The replacement applies when you hold the matching weapon. An AK-47 package, for example, belongs to the AK-47. Keep the package's world and first-person resources together in their original locations. The First-person weapon option controls whether the replacement is also used for the weapon in your hands. An unrecognized weapon target or incomplete package can block Apply. Turn models off or clear assignments Custom models toggle: switch custom replacements off while keeping your selections. Default model → Apply model: clear the selected target's assignment. Players can fall back to a team/global choice; arms can follow the Self body. Reset All: clear custom-model assignments and turn the feature off. Installed package files remain on disk. Troubleshooting The model is missing from the list Check the exact game\csgo folder and the package's original directory structure, then press Refresh list . Make sure the archive is extracted and contains compiled .vmdl_c files. Choose the correct tab: arms and weapons have their own lists. Player discovery filters unrelated map props. If the library reports a scan limit, reduce the installed collection while testing. Package needs attention / Apply is unavailable Wait if the preview says Checking package... . Otherwise click the package-details message below the preview to see which dependency is missing. Install the complete compatible bundle, restart CS2 and refresh the list. Old packages may reference animation graphs removed by a game update and need a new build from their author. The preview is empty or the wrong model appears Check the selected scope and the Assigned label. A preview selection becomes an assignment only after Apply. Default arms and weapon previews need a loaded local player and the corresponding model. A package with missing geometry, materials or animations needs corrected assets. Hands, death poses or animations look wrong Clear any separate arms override, check the package's first-person support, and compare with Default. If one custom package alone produces a broken death pose or animation, it may have incompatible skeleton, animation or physics data. Use a compatible version of that package and include its name and resource path when reporting the problem. Frame rate drops with a model Test one replacement at a time, then compare with Default in the same scene. Large textures, detailed meshes and bundled effects can add rendering cost. Close the preview when finished and refresh after file changes. Background scanning reduces menu stalls, but it does not make every custom asset inexpensive to render. Models stopped applying after a CS2 update Check Features Not Working After an Update and use a Scooby build that matches the current game. For package-specific help, share the affected tab, package name, resource path and the exact Package details message with the Scooby community .

title: Connection & SSL errors
text: Connection & SSL errors Connection checks Backend / hosting issues SSL / certificate errors Test another network Free connection options Still stuck? Work through these in order Check that other websites open. If everything is offline, fix your network connection first. Retry the official Scooby website and loader after a short wait. An outage or maintenance can affect both. Open Windows Settings → Time & language → Date & time . Correct the date, time and time zone; use Sync now if available. Restart the browser or loader. Finish a hotel, school or public Wi-Fi sign-in page in the browser if one is required. If a VPN or proxy is already enabled, disconnect it briefly and test again. Restore your normal setting afterward. The backend or hosting provider may be having issues If the loader cannot connect or keeps timing out even on a different network, the backend service or its server-hosting provider may be unavailable . Hosting-provider outages can be outside Scooby’s direct control ; they are not something you can fix on your PC. Check for official service updates, wait for the service to recover, and try again later. A VPN or proxy can help with network restrictions, but it cannot fix a backend or hosting outage . If the error mentions SSL or a certificate A certificate error is not proof that your ISP blocks Scooby. A wrong clock, outdated Windows, a sign-in portal, security software inspecting HTTPS or a server problem can all cause it. Correct the clock, apply Windows updates, then restart. Check antivirus history for a named web-protection block. Follow the vendor’s official help for that detection. Do not bypass certificate warnings, install an unknown root certificate or disable the firewall to make the message disappear. Check whether the network is the problem If the error remains, try a trusted alternative connection, such as your phone’s hotspot. If it works there, the original network may be filtering the connection. Your ISP or country may restrict access to some websites. “Server not found” or “This site can’t be reached” can also mean a DNS problem or temporary website outage. A VPN can help diagnose routing or filtering problems on your own network, but it cannot fix every SSL or authentication error. If you already use one, test another server or test with it disconnected. On a work or school network, ask the administrator about its access rules. Try a free connection option If you suspect network filtering, connect through a VPN or trusted proxy and retry the website or restart the loader and try connecting again. These providers offer free options: Cloudflare 1.1.1.1 with WARP — free app . Enable WARP in the app, then retry the website or loader. Proton VPN — free plan available . Connect using the free plan, then retry the website or loader. If the free-key website opens afterward, continue its normal access steps. A VPN does not replace those steps. If you still need help Include the exact error text, whether it happens in the browser or loader, your Windows version, antivirus name, and whether the hotspot test changed anything. Hide passwords, keys and other private details. If the network works but sign-in fails, follow authentication troubleshooting . For an HWID mismatch, use the portal reset guide ; resets have a 7-day cooldown.

title: Crashes & loading errors
text: Crashes & loading errors Start here Missing runtimes Reset settings Still crashing? Try these first Close Scooby and the game. Restart the PC if they will not close normally. Launch the game without Scooby once. If it still crashes, repair the game first using its launcher’s Verify / Repair option. Download the current loader from Scooby’s website and follow your game’s setup guide . Use the correct edition and account tier. Read any antivirus alert before changing settings. A missing or quarantined file belongs in antivirus & download help . Apply pending Windows updates and get graphics drivers from your GPU maker. Test again after restarting. Missing DLL or Visual C++ error? Install or repair the current Microsoft Visual C++ Redistributable packages. On a 64-bit Windows gaming PC, install both packages below, then restart. Microsoft Visual C++ · x64 ↗ Microsoft Visual C++ · x86 ↗ Use Microsoft installers rather than downloading individual DLL files from a DLL website. For DirectX errors, repair the game’s prerequisites through its launcher. Test with fresh settings without losing your backup Close both Scooby and the game. Open File Explorer with Win + E . Check C:\scooby and your Documents\Scooby folder; use the one that actually contains your settings. Press Alt + D to enter a folder path in the address bar. Select the Scooby data folder and press F2 , or right-click it and choose the Rename icon. Enter an unused backup name, such as scooby-backup , then press Enter . Keep its scripts, outfits and presets in the backup. Do not rename a whole Documents folder or the loader executable. Open Scooby so it can create fresh settings. Test without imported scripts, themes or presets. If it works, restore your saved items gradually to find the cause. If it does not, close Scooby before restoring the original folder name. Enlarge screenshot ↗ Choose Rename, or press F2. Microsoft’s Windows 11 reference shows a file menu; the same Rename icon works on folders. Apply it to your Scooby data folder, then use a backup name. Microsoft screenshot and instructions ↗ . Still crashing? Check the exact loader error and your game’s troubleshooting page. If asking for help, include the game and edition, where the crash happens, the exact error and the steps you already tried. A screenshot is more useful than “it does not work”. For GTA 5, keep the Free Version Setup and Plus Setup instructions separate: their BattlEye requirements differ.

title: Get a free key
text: Get a free key Access steps Copy key Free login Premium & redeem Website won’t open? Key-page problems Free version limits 1. Complete the access steps Choose Get a free key . Complete each action shown on that page, then return to check its Unlock progress . Actions may change; follow the current page. When all required actions are complete, choose Unlock Link . In the loader, choose Free and paste it into Free key . Choose Sign in . Free keys work only in the loader’s Free login. Free keys reset every 24 hours , so you need to get a new free key every 24 hours. Complete the access steps again, copy the new key and use it in the loader’s Free tab. You do not need a separate key for each game. Enlarge screenshot ↗ Choose Free → paste the copied free key → Sign in. Get a free key opens the access page. Download the loader from the Scooby portal using your normal website account if asked. Your website account and your loader free key are different login methods; the free key does not sign you in to the website. Once signed in, choose your game’s loading guide and follow the screenshots. Have a purchased Premium license instead? Redeem it on your Scooby account , then use Premium in the loader with that account’s username and password. Website or loader won’t connect? If you see “This site can’t be reached” , “Server not found” or a connection timeout , or the loader cannot connect , your ISP or country may be blocking the connection. DNS problems or a temporary service outage can also cause these errors. Check the address and try refreshing the page. Try a different connection, such as your phone’s hotspot. If it still will not open, try a VPN or trusted proxy , then reopen the original free-key link or restart the loader and retry. Free connection options: Cloudflare 1.1.1.1 with WARP — free app . Enable WARP in the app, then retry the website or loader. Proton VPN — free plan available . Connect using the free plan, then retry the website or loader. A VPN can help with network restrictions, but it will not fix every website or loader connection error. You still need to complete the free-key access steps. For more checks, see Connection & SSL errors . It may be the backend or server hosting If the loader still cannot connect on another network, the backend or hosting provider may be having an outage. Hosting issues can be outside Scooby’s direct control. Wait for service to return and retry later; a VPN cannot fix a server-side outage. See backend & hosting connection help . Having trouble on the key page? Try an up-to-date Edge, Chrome or Firefox browser if the page does not complete. Close advert pop-ups. The key is text, never an executable or a separate installer . Get the loader from Scooby’s main website, not from an advert on the key page. Paste the full key without extra spaces. If it has expired, generate a new one. Keep your key private. Support does not need your password or key to read an error message. Check the free version’s limits For GTA Online, the free version supports invite-only / solo play or compatible sessions with other modders. It does not support normal public lobbies; joining one can crash the game. Read GTA 5 Free Version Setup for the current game-edition and online-access instructions. If old settings cause a crash after an update, follow the settings-backup steps instead of deleting your files immediately.

title: Resetting Your HWID
text: Resetting Your HWID 7-day cooldown after every reset After resetting your HWID, you must wait 7 full days before you can reset it again. Do not open a support ticket to request a reset. Support will not reset your HWID for you or shorten the cooldown. If you are on cooldown, wait until it ends, then use the portal. If you have changed hardware or see an HWID mismatch, use the Reset HWID card on the portal dashboard. You can do this once your reset is available. Reset from the dashboard Open scoobymenu.cc/portal and sign in to your account. Select Dashboard and find the Reset HWID card. On a phone, scroll down to it. Read Reset availability . If it says Ready to reset , you can continue. If it says Available in… , wait for the remaining time to end. Click Reset HWID . Read the confirmation, then select Reset HWID again when you are ready. Select Cancel if you do not want to reset. These screenshots show the current portal with an example account. Your account name, products and remaining wait time will differ. Enlarge screenshot ↗ 1. Open Dashboard, check Ready to reset, then choose Reset HWID in the outlined card. Confirm the reset The confirmation opens before the reset is submitted. Check that you want to reset now: completing it starts the 7-day cooldown for your next reset. Enlarge screenshot ↗ 2. Choose Reset HWID to confirm, or Cancel to leave without resetting. If the button is unavailable Available in… means your reset is on cooldown. The button stays disabled while you wait. After the full 7 days have passed since your last reset, refresh the dashboard to check availability again. Enlarge screenshot ↗ Cooldown example: read the remaining time in Reset availability. Your account may show a shorter time. Support will not reset your HWID for you or bypass the cooldown. Do not create a ticket to request an early reset. Can I still use My profile? Yes. Open My account in the top right → My profile → Hardware ID . The same reset availability and 7-day cooldown apply. The dashboard is the shorter route.

title: Use Scooby on Linux & Mac
text: Use Scooby on Linux & Mac Get ready Steam on Linux Steam Deck / Flatpak Wine / Lutris Mac Troubleshooting Compatibility preview. Game support is still being tested. What works and what to expect . 1. Get ready Download and extract Scooby. Get Scooby-compatibility.zip from Scooby downloads and extract the whole ZIP. Keep all the files together. If you only see the Windows installer, ask support for the compatibility preview . Check your game works first. Open the Windows version of your game through its usual launcher at least once. It needs to work on its own before you add Scooby. Open a terminal in the extracted folder. Open the folder containing linux , right-click an empty area and choose Open in Terminal , if your file manager offers it. New to the terminal? Start here A terminal lets you run the short commands in this guide. On Steam Deck, use Desktop Mode and open Konsole . Paste a command with Ctrl + Shift + V , then press Enter . Keep the terminal in the extracted folder that contains linux . If you opened it elsewhere, type cd followed by that folder's full path in quotes, then press Enter. Run Scooby as your normal user, without sudo . The launch scripts need Python 3.10 or newer . Check with this command: python3 --version A result such as Python 3.12.3 is fine. If Python is missing or older than 3.10, install it using your system's supported package manager. 2. Choose your setup Open the option that matches how you start your game. You only need to follow one. Linux with Steam I launch my game from my Steam library. Install Protontricks. Follow the official installation instructions . Installed it through Discover or as a Flatpak? Use the Steam Deck / Flatpak steps instead. Start your game once with Proton. In Steam, open the game's Properties → Compatibility , select the Proton version you use for the Windows game, then launch it. Find your game number. Run this command. Look for your game in the list; the number next to it is its App ID . protontricks -l Your game's App ID Paste the number next to your game. Your launch command will update below. Replace APPID in the command below with the number next to your game. Open Scooby. Copy the command below into your terminal and press Enter. sh linux/launch.sh --runner proton --appid APPID The Scooby sign-in window should open. Then continue to Start playing . Keep using your game's usual Steam entry. Adding Scooby as a separate non-Steam game can put it in the wrong Windows environment. Advanced: I use a custom Steam data folder Only use this if you changed the game's Steam compatdata location. Replace the path with the folder containing pfx , not pfx itself. sh linux/launch.sh --runner proton --appid APPID --compat-data "/path/to/compatdata/APPID" The App ID field fills in the game number. You still need to replace the example folder path. Steam Deck / Flatpak I use a Steam Deck, or installed Protontricks through Flatpak. Use Desktop Mode. On Steam Deck, open Discover , search for Protontricks and install it. Leave SteamOS in its normal read-only state. Start the Windows game once through Steam. Use its usual Proton version. Keep the extracted Scooby folder open in your terminal. Find your game's App ID. Run this command and find the number next to your game. flatpak run com.github.Matoking.protontricks -l Your game's App ID Paste the number next to your game. Your launch command will update below. Replace APPID in the command below with the number next to your game. Open Scooby. Copy this command into the terminal and press Enter. sh linux/launch.sh --runner proton --flatpak --appid APPID When the sign-in window appears, continue to Start playing . Use Desktop Mode with a mouse or trackpad for now. Game Mode, controller navigation and suspend/resume are not yet verified. My game is on an SD card or another drive Protontricks may need permission to access that Steam library. Follow its Flatpak access instructions . The Scooby launcher already grants access to its own bin folder for each run. Linux with Lutris / Wine I use Lutris, Rockstar Games Launcher or another Wine setup. Using Lutris? You can set up a shortcut. Scooby needs the same Windows folder and Wine version as your game. Open your game's configuration in Lutris. Note the Wine prefix and Wine version . The prefix is the folder containing the game's Windows files. Add a locally installed game. Name it Scooby, choose the Wine runner, and select linux/bin/ScoobyLoader.exe from your extracted package. Match the two settings. Use the exact same Wine prefix and Wine version as your game. Leave the bundled DLL files beside ScoobyLoader.exe . Save and launch Scooby. Once the sign-in window opens, continue to Start playing . I use Wine directly, without Lutris Replace both paths with your game's Wine executable and existing prefix folder. Keep the quotes around the paths. sh linux/launch.sh --runner wine --wine "/path/to/wine" --prefix "/path/to/game-prefix" The prefix is the folder containing drive_c . It must already be set up and support 64-bit Windows apps. The launcher does not create or repair it. Do not use plain Wine on a Steam Proton prefix. Mac I have a Mac-compatible Wine setup for my Windows game. Mac support is unverified . You need Python 3.10+ and a Mac-compatible Wine version that runs Windows x64 apps. On Apple silicon, that Wine distribution must also provide the required translation and graphics support. Confirm your Windows game works first. Find the Wine executable and prefix used by that game. Open Terminal in the extracted Scooby folder. Replace both example paths, then run: sh linux/mac/launch.command --wine "/absolute/path/to/wine" --prefix "/absolute/path/to/game-prefix" Continue to Start playing if the sign-in window opens. Using CrossOver? Follow its instructions to run Scooby in the same bottle as your game. This script does not configure CrossOver bottles automatically. Double-clicking the script without the paths above will not set it up. Proton is Linux-only. 3. Start playing Sign in to Scooby. Use your account or follow the free-key guide . Open your game as usual. Use the Steam or Lutris entry you set up above. Follow your game's loading steps. Open its Scooby guide to check when to load the menu. Timing and game support vary. Next time: use the same launch command or Lutris shortcut. Close both the game and Scooby before changing Wine or Proton versions. Something not working? Pick the problem you see. “File not found” or the launch script will not open Open the extracted folder that contains linux , then open a terminal there. Check that linux/bin/ScoobyLoader.exe exists. Extract the whole compatibility ZIP again if files are missing; the standard Windows installer does not include these scripts. “Python not found” or “Runner not found” Check python3 --version ; you need 3.10 or newer. For Steam, install Protontricks. If you installed it through Discover or Flatpak, follow the Flatpak steps . For Wine, check the Wine executable path. Scooby cannot find my game Run the Windows version of the game and check your App ID. In Lutris, Scooby and the game must share the exact same Wine prefix and Wine version . A native Linux game cannot load the Windows menu. If these match, the game may still be incompatible with this preview. The window is blank, or text is missing Keep all the runtime DLLs beside the loader and check that your game works with the selected runner. For missing Segoe UI text, add a licensed copy of segoeui.ttf to the same prefix's drive_c/windows/Fonts folder, then restart Scooby. A graphics error may need help with your Wine/Proton setup. I need to update Scooby or find my settings Close Scooby, then download and extract the latest compatibility package. Updates are manual; an old package can be blocked by a required minimum version. Your settings are inside the game's prefix at drive_c/scooby (the Windows path C:\scooby ). Each prefix has separate data. If changing prefixes causes an HWID mismatch, follow the HWID reset guide . The game is running slowly Compare the game with and without Scooby using the same settings. Performance depends on your graphics drivers, Wine/Proton version and enabled menu features. Close both apps before testing a different runner, and keep the game and loader on the same version. I need more help / want to check my setup Add --diagnose to the end of your launch command. It prints a setup report without opening Scooby. This checks local files and launch options; it does not prove that login, graphics, Steam/Flatpak access or game loading will work. Send Scooby support your OS, game, Wine/Proton version and exact error. Remove private details from reports and never share passwords or license keys. What works and what to expect This package runs the Windows x64 loader through Wine or Proton. Login, graphics and in-game loading still need testing on real Linux, Steam Deck and Mac systems. No game is certified yet; the loader opening does not guarantee that its menu will work. Windows-only cleaner, identifier and kernel-driver tools are unavailable. Native Linux/Mac games cannot load Windows DLLs. Game and anti-cheat restrictions still apply.

title: Loader troubleshooting
text: Loader troubleshooting Loader will not open Failed to inject Failed to find patterns Auth / connection Files & scripts GTA Online Loader will not open or closes straight away Close old loader processes, restart Windows and download the current loader from scoobymenu.cc . Read antivirus history and download help if the file is missing or blocked. For missing-runtime or DLL errors, use the Microsoft runtime installers . If Windows says access is denied, use a folder owned by your Windows account. If your game guide requires elevation, right-click the verified loader and choose Run as administrator. “Failed to inject module” or “Not injecting” Check the selected game and edition, then follow the loading order in its setup guide . Do not use one game’s loading steps for another. For GTA 5, follow the BattlEye setting for your tier: Free Version Setup or Plus Setup . Read the antivirus detection history. An exclusion is a deliberate exception for a verified file; do not exclude the whole C:\ drive. See your antivirus instructions . Close both apps and try fresh settings with a backup . If the error names a folder-access problem, check the actual save path and free disk space. A OneDrive path alone does not prove it is the cause. “Failed to Find Patterns” or trouble after a game update Check that the loader and your game build are supported together. A game update can change files the menu expects. Use the current loader and check Scooby’s update announcements before trying repeated loads. Keep the exact error text and game build for support. Turning off more Windows settings will not repair an unsupported game build. “Auth Failed”, connection or sign-in errors Confirm you are using the right account or a current free key . Check your clock and use the connection & SSL checklist . Do not repeatedly reset your HWID for a network error. If connection attempts time out across different networks, the backend or its hosting provider may be having issues . Hosting outages can be outside Scooby’s direct control. Wait for the service to recover, then try again; a VPN cannot repair a server-side outage. If the loader specifically reports an HWID mismatch, follow Reset your HWID . Each reset starts a 7-day cooldown; support will not reset it manually. Scooby folder or subscribed scripts missing? Check both C:\scooby and Documents\Scooby . Documents may be redirected to OneDrive; check the actual location instead of uninstalling OneDrive. For subscribed scripts, verify you are signed in to the expected account and the loader can connect. Restart it after checking your subscription. Test with a clean settings backup before reimporting scripts. Use the game-specific Lua guide for installation and reload steps. GTA Online errors or BattlEye kicks Online access and BattlEye requirements differ between Free, Premium and Plus. Read the tier comparison and public-session guide for the mode you use. If the game reports a graphics or fatal error, note its exact code, verify game files and test the game without Scooby. A kick or error message by itself does not establish its cause or a guaranteed waiting period. Avoid broad “fixes” Do not give Everyone full control of your C: drive, uninstall OneDrive or delete all settings as a first step. Use the exact error to identify the file or folder involved. For Windows corruption messages, use Microsoft’s repair guidance or ask for help before changing system permissions.

title: Website or loader won't connect: VPN & network help
text: The website or loader says server not found, site cannot be reached or connection timed out. Check the address, try a hotspot, or test a VPN or trusted proxy. ISP or country restrictions, DNS problems and temporary outages are possible causes. Free options: Cloudflare 1.1.1.1 with WARP and Proton VPN. Backend or hosting-provider outages can be outside Scooby's direct control; wait and retry later. A VPN cannot fix a server outage.

title: Loader connection: backend & hosting outages
text: The loader cannot connect or keeps timing out across different networks. Backend services or server-hosting providers may be having an outage outside Scooby's direct control. Wait for recovery and retry later. A VPN or proxy cannot fix a server-side outage.
